lines.text: His loud humming gets on my nerves.

data.define: Used when something or someone bothers you.

example.text: His loud humming gets on my nerves.

misuse.text: Don't tell your teacher she 'gets on your nerves'.

publish.title: What does "get on my nerves" mean?
publish.value: Get on my nerves = It really annoys me. Example: "His loud humming gets on my nerves." (casual English).
